title: Upstream 5xx storm opens the upstream breaker while /healthz keeps answering
notes: Load is POST /mcp, a JSON-RPC tools/call of ultrathink_uplift (mcp/mcp.ts UPLIFT_TOOL, routes/router.ts mcpRoute). It is the only HTTP route that starts a headless planner job: POST /ultrathink only queues a run and never reaches the upstream. The fault sits in the plan backend's claude seam (chaos/faults.ts createFaultyClaude): each injected 503 is the error the CLI raises for an API failure and reaches the planner as a PlanCompleterError of class upstream. The planner reports one breaker failure per call, with no retry layer, so the third failed call opens the breaker (breakerFailures 3) and the calls after it are refused with outcome upstream_unavailable; settle therefore counts requests minus breakerFailures. Load runs one request at a time so the order of calls is unambiguous. The harness must enable server planning and present the connector key; this template holds no credential.

arguments.prompt: chaos probe: outline a rollout plan
